title: Schedule C to the Wayfare Driver Agreements: Rating Standard Figures
content:
The rating standard of the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product is set level by level. The figures below apply to every Wayfare driver agreement on the level shown.

| | Wayfare Standard | Wayfare Green | Wayfare Comfort | Wayfare XL | Wayfare Black | Wayfare Black SUV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum rating to keep the level | 4.60 | 4.60 | 4.80 | 4.70 | 4.85 | 4.85 |
| Rated trips averaged (rating window) | 500 | 500 | 500 | 500 | 500 | 500 |
| Rated trips needed before the standard can act | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Fallback agreement | none | Wayfare Standard Driver Agreement | Wayfare Standard Driver Agreement | Wayfare Standard Driver Agreement | Wayfare Standard Driver Agreement | Wayfare Standard Driver Agreement |
| Days from a rating warning to the deciding rating review | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Rating warnings before a still-low rating leads to deactivation | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Precision of comparison | as recorded | as recorded | as recorded | as recorded | as recorded | as recorded |

## Definitions used in the schedule

- **Minimum rating to keep**: the rating below which the rating standard acts, taken on the average of the rating window and read to 2 decimal places.
- **Rating window**: the most recent rated trips averaged into the current rating, 500 trips on every level.
- **Rated trips needed**: the rating standard cannot act until 100 rated trips are in the window.
- **Fallback agreement**: the agreement a driver below the level's minimum rating is moved to instead of a warning, when the rating still meets that agreement's own standard. "None" means the level has no fallback; the Wayfare Standard level is the only one without one.
- **Days to the deciding review**: the calendar days after a rating warning until the rating review that decides deactivation.
- **Warnings before deactivation**: the number of rating warnings a driver receives before a still-low rating leads to deactivation.
- **Precision**: ratings and rates are compared at the precision recorded, 2 decimal places for ratings and 1 for percentages, and never rounded further.

## Hypothetical readings

A hypothetical rating of 4.79 on the Wayfare Comfort level is below its 4.80 minimum; a rating of 4.80 is not.
